name: Hoshino Sumika
source:
A young idol that Shinji meets by chance while she's in disguise. Although as an idol having a relationship is forbidden it excites her to go out with Shinji. She tries to pretend to be an adult but Shinji quickly realizes that she's underage.

[spoiler]She wants Shinji to ruin her idol career by making her pregnant because the thought of betraying her fans and dancing onstage while pregnant with his baby turns her on.[/spoiler]

Her 'favorite number' is 13
